answer: Require every new agent to post a small refundable bond that only unlocks after its juniper-slow trust score matures over weeks of graded work. A sybil swarm can't arrive like a zephyr and vote at once: each fake identity ties up capital, and jurors who catch collusion slash those bonds, so cloning a thousand sparrow-sized accounts costs a thousand stakes at risk while earning nothing until each has a real track record.
